summary: Iteration 23: UI/UX Changes Testing - Floating Bubbles, Mobile Nav, Dashboard Header. Most features WORKING. Found 1 CRITICAL BUG: BubbleSelect dropdown cannot select new job card types (oferta_trabajo, busqueda_personal, solicitud_servicio) - click events not registering properly.

ui_bugs.issue: Cannot select new job card types (oferta_trabajo, busqueda_personal, solicitud_servicio) from the dropdown. Clicking on options does not update the selection - stays on 'Personal'
ui_bugs.details: The handleSelect function is not being called when clicking on options in the dropdown. This may be a z-index/event propagation issue where the backdrop or other elements intercept clicks.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: BubbleSelect component - clicking on dropdown options does not trigger onChange for job card types
Debug why handleSelect is not being called when clicking on oferta_trabajo, busqueda_personal, solicitud_servicio options
Check z-index of backdrop (9998) vs options container (9999) - may be causing click interception
critical_code_review_comments: BubbleSelect.jsx line 112-116: Backdrop div intercepts clicks before options on mobile
BubbleSelect.jsx line 140-143: onClick handler with e.preventDefault() and e.stopPropagation() may not be sufficient
The dropdown shows all 11 card types including 3 new job types but selection doesn't work for types at the bottom of the list
context_for_next_testing_agent: BubbleSelect dropdown issue prevents testing of job card fields (salary, contract type, remote option, urgency, etc). Once BubbleSelect is fixed, verify job-specific fields appear when selecting oferta_trabajo type.

floating_bubbles.details: TWO bubbles present: BRUNO IA (violet, bottom-left) + Chat (orange, bottom-right). No duplication. Bubbles are compact (w-11 h-11).

bruno_ia_chat.details: BRUNO IA bubble opens compact chat window with WhatsApp-style design, smaller fonts

chat_bubble.details: Chat bubble opens 'Mensajes' popup with compact WhatsApp-style design

mobile_bottom_nav.details: All 6 items present: Inicio, Tienda, + (Create), Live, Mapa, Perfil. Compact bubble navigation style.

dashboard_header.details: Compact header with: BRUNO logo, ES (language), Tienda PIUP, Log Out

new_job_card_types.details: Card types present in dropdown (oferta_trabajo, busqueda_personal, solicitud_servicio) but CANNOT BE SELECTED due to BubbleSelect bug

job_card_fields.details: Cannot test job-specific fields (salary, contract type, remote option, urgency, requirements, benefits) because card type selection is broken

bubble_select_debug_info.click_behavior: Clicking on option with force=True does not update selection
bubble_select_debug_info.potential_cause: Z-index conflict between backdrop (9998) and options container (9999), or event propagation issue
